segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin report the cleanser removes excess sebum and manages shine without over-drying, though one notes it did not prevent breakouts when paired with the brand's moisturizer.
segments.dry: A few reviewers mention dry skin or dry climates and say the cleanser does not strip or worsen dryness, with one exception reporting chapped, cracked lips.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report reduced greasiness and blackheads in the T-zone alongside calmer, less broken-out skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most divided group: many say it is gentle, non-irritating and even calms redness, while several others report new irritation, redness, breakouts, or in one case severe barrier damage.
segments.mature: One reviewer with dry, stressed, red skin (implied mature/compromised skin) reports the product restored hydration and reduced redness.
segments.normal: One reviewer without acne-prone skin still reports softer skin and reduced pore size, describing this as unexpected.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the cleanser does not strip or over-dry skin and even helps with tightness or dryness elsewhere in their routine; a minority disagree, reporting dryness, tight skin, or chapped lips after use.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness, including one describing neutralized rosacea redness and another whose chronic facial redness improved; conversely, some report new redness and irritation after use, and one describes a severe dermatitis reaction.
concerns.barrier: Most describe the product as barrier-friendly, non-stripping and gentle enough for daily use; one reviewer reports a dermatologist-diagnosed case of extreme barrier damage requiring steroid treatment.
concerns.spots: Numerous reviewers report fewer whiteheads, blackheads, and clearer pores, including reduced sebaceous filaments and smaller-looking pores; no dissent specific to spots was found.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, especially those identifying as acne-prone, report fewer breakouts, calmer hormonal or cystic acne, and long-term clearing; a minority report increased breakouts or irritation, including one describing worsened acne when combined with another product in the line.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser manages excess oil and shine without over-drying, though it is not described as reducing oil production itself.

aspects.libelle: No exfoliating beads despite product name

extraits.titre: Don't Use If You Have Acne Prone Skin
extraits.texte: I have acne prone skin and using this with their face moisturizer caused me to break out more didnt prevent breakout at all. If you have sensitive and acne prone skin i highly suggest you pay a little more for a better quality face wash.

I never leave reviews but I MUST worn others about this cleanser. This is hands down the worst product I have ever used on my skin in my entire life. For context, I've always had great skin and have never been sensitive to any products. I've tried just about everything on the market with no issues. I only used this because I got a sample with another purchase while I was out of my usual face wash. Within a few days, I broke out into one of the worst dermatitis reactions I could have ever imagined across most of my face. It's been almost a month, and I'm still dealing with it. I even went to a dermatologist, who said it's extreme barrier damage caused by this product and that it could take several more weeks to clear up… hopefully. I'm now on a mix of steroids, and my skin honestly looks worse than it ever has at any point in my life. I'm beyond frustrated and genuinely devastated that trying this product caused this much damage to what was previously very resilient, non-sensitive skin. This product deserves a million negative starts. Do NOT recommend unless you want to spend months repairing skin barrier damage! :(

extraits.titre: Reduces shine and texture, but too drying for everyday use.
extraits.texte: Looks and feels like a traditional cleanser in that it smells like soap and is ever-so-slightly lathers when rubbing into the skin. Once rinsed, the skin feels and looks smoother with no shine. Unfortunately, this seems to come at the expense of hydration. The skin doesn't feel completely stripped but definitely requires immediate follow-up with a moisturizing product to avoid skin tightness.

Expensive is not always better. I would actually pay triple what this costs its that good!!!! Removes makeup super easy, gently exfoliate with super tiny tiny beads, leaves face so incredibly soft! I have mild rosacea and after I pat dry my redness is actually nutrealized! I feel almost no need to use any other products like moisturizer or serum or anything. I never wrote reviews but have to share this one. you wont regret it!

I tried this cleanser on a whim. I have combination skin and am acne prone. This cleanser has helped keep my breakouts at bay! I've noticed far less greasiness and oiliness around my t-zone, and literally no blackheads anymore! I stopped using this product for a few days and immediately noticed its absence in my skincare routine as I started to become more oily and have tiny breakouts. This is sooo gentle, non-drying, and simply luxurious. It also has a pleasant scent and smoothness to it that I have no experienced with any other cleanser. I will keep using this for sure as it is the only cleanser I've tried that has actually helped my skin become soft and less red/broken out!

I've tried it all! I have oily, acne prone skin. I have tried dermalogica, prescriptions, facials, neutrogenia, luxury products, etc and nothing worked for me. I always had breakouts. This cleanser and toner are miracle workers. My face calmed down, no new acne spots in months and my oily skin is more manageable even in the hot Arizona summers.
